# Brief 05: Investor update

Audience: Solstice Software shareholders and analysts (quarterly update).
Decision: none; the aim is to show that growth and retention support the raised full-year guidance.
Format: 9 slides, density balanced. Start with a cover and end with next steps.
Data: data.csv holds ARR by quarter and segment used on slides 3 and 4.

## Facts

F1: Annual recurring revenue (ARR, USD million) by quarter: Q3 2024 150, Q4 2024 158, Q1 2025 167, Q2 2025 176, Q3 2025 186; growth of 24% year on year.
F2: ARR by segment at Q3 2025 (USD million): mid-market 98, enterprise 61, small business 27; total 186.
F3: Net revenue retention by quarter (%): Q3 2024 104, Q4 2024 106, Q1 2025 108, Q2 2025 110, Q3 2025 112.
F4: Net revenue retention by segment at Q3 2025: enterprise 118%, mid-market 111%, small business 98%.
F5: ARR bridge Q3 2024 to Q3 2025 (USD million): start 150, new customers +28, expansion +19, churn -8, contraction -3, end 186.
F6: Gross margin is 78%; free cash flow in the quarter was $9M; customers total 2,140.
F7: Gross churn fell from 7.4% to 6.1% over the year.
F8: Full-year 2025 revenue guidance is raised to $226M to $230M from $220M to $224M.
F9: Small business ARR is 15% of the total but its net retention is below 100%.
F10: Currency moves cost about 2 points of reported growth in the quarter.
F11: Priorities for Q4: launch the analytics module, hire 40 enterprise sales staff and lift small business retention above 100%.
